## Online-only / bonus content
The book says these sections are online-only. They are not in the PDF, and the links are in the GitHub repo.
- **Ch 1:** history and background of .NET (p. 14).
- **Ch 2:** tables of new C# language features by version (p. 14–15). There is also an optional VS Code section (p. 53) and a Polyglot Notebooks section (p. 61).
- **Ch 4:** logging exceptions at runtime and basic logging (p. 196, 239). Result types are also online (p. 192).
- **Ch 6:** analyzers (p. 16, 376), reference vs value types and memory management (p. 314, 376), and comparing objects with a separate class (p. 342).
- **Ch 7:** tables of new .NET library features by version (p. 14, 16). There are also three online sections: legacy .NET Framework libraries, porting from .NET Framework (the book says "porting legacy .NET Framework code bases"), and source generators (p. 16, 380). A "Decompiling .NET assemblies" section is also online (p. 380).
- **Ch 8:** working with a network using low-level types, and spans, indexes, and ranges (p. 16, 428, 482).
- **Ch 9:** working with tar archives on Linux (p. 16).
- **Ch 10:** three sections on Code First models, insert/update/delete, and transactions (p. 17).
- **Ch 11:** three sections on parallel LINQ, LINQ to XML, and custom LINQ extension methods (p. 17).
- **Ch 13:** two sections on customizing the HTTP pipeline and enabling HTTP/3 (p. 17).
- **Ch 15:** two sections on health checks and security headers, and Minimal API with native AOT (p. 17).

## C# 14 / .NET 10 features the book highlights
Each entry gives the chapter and the PDF page where the book discusses it.

**C# 14**
- **`field` keyword for properties:** Ch 5, section "Implementing properties using the `field` keyword" (p. 16, 292–296). It was a preview feature in C# 13 and is standard in C# 14 (p. 296).
- **Partial events and instance constructors:** Ch 5. Before C# 14, `partial` could not decorate these members (p. 16, 295, 311).
- **Extension members (extension blocks):** Ch 6, section "Extension members" (p. 16, 373–376). Extension methods date from C# 3. C# 14 adds static methods, instance properties, and static properties, using extension blocks (p. 373–374). Old extension-method syntax and the new block syntax can be used together (p. 375).
- **Null-conditional assignment operator:** Ch 3, section "Null-conditional assignment operator" (p. 15, 142–143).
- **`nameof` with unbound generic types:** Ch 2 (p. 15, 90).
- **File-based apps (running a `.cs` file without a project file):** Ch 1. It is described as a C# 14 / .NET 10 feature and uses `#:package` and `#:sdk` directives (p. 15, 57–59).
- **C# 14 compiler:** Ch 2 explains compiler versions and that .NET 10 ships the C# 14 compiler (p. 68–70).

**.NET 10 and other additions**
- **Noun-first aliases for `dotnet` CLI commands:** Ch 7 (p. 16, 403–404).
- **`CompareOptions.NumericOrdering` for string comparison:** Ch 8 (p. 16, 441).
- **Async ZIP APIs (`ZipFile.CreateFromDirectoryAsync` / `ExtractToDirectoryAsync`):** Ch 9 (p. 16, 512).
- **JSON Patch implementation based on System.Text.Json:** Ch 9 (p. 16, 528).
- **`LeftJoin` and `RightJoin` LINQ methods:** Ch 11 (p. 17, 593, 628).
- **`.slnx` solution files:** Ch 1 (p. 54–55). Chapters 1–11 each have their own `.slnx` file, and Chapters 12–15 share `ModernWeb.slnx`.
- **Visual Studio 2026:** Ch 1 (p. 24).
- **Earlier-version features the preface also calls out:**
  - `MapStaticAssets` (.NET 9), Ch 13.
  - The Microsoft OpenAPI generator, Ch 15.
  - .NET 9's `CountBy`, `AggregateBy`, and `Index` in LINQ, Ch 11.
  - Removal of `BinaryFormatter` and the JSON schema exporter (.NET 9), Ch 9.
  - Central Package Management, Ch 12.
- **New in the 10th edition, not tied to a C# or .NET version:**
  - A section on dynamic types with `ExpandoObject`, Ch 2 (p. 15, 107–108).
  - A section on early-return / guard-clause `if` statements, Ch 3 (p. 15, 150–151).
  - A section on Microsoft Learn's MCP server for AI integration, Appendix C (p. 18).
